high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Art Newspaper" displayed on a tablet or smartphone screen. The article is titled "Football great Lionel Messi chooses favourite goal for Refik Anadol to transform into an AI portrait for charity." The article discusses how the renowned football player Lionel Messi has selected one of his favorite goals to be reimagined by the media artist Refik Anadol as a data sculpture. This artwork will be sold at Christie's auction house to benefit charity.
